insights.summary: Sansera's Q2 FY27 presentation shows a record quarter: revenue ₹1,091.5 Cr (+32% YoY), EBITDA ₹211 Cr (19.4% margin) and profit after tax ₹108.6 Cr (+52%). Non-auto reached 20.9% of sales as ADS revenue rose 207%, and Auto ICE fell to 65.7%. ADS backlog is ₹5,870 Cr over five years and peak annual revenue from other new orders ₹2,241 Cr. Management keeps the FY27 ADS guide at ₹550-600 Cr and plans about ₹800 Cr of capex. There is no call transcript yet, so FY27 growth and margin guidance from August cannot be updated.
